purpose: Describe the final Studio-to-owner acceptance journey and keep each unavailable lane explicit until owner evidence is merged and independently exercised.

journey.action: admit a workflow definition, target descriptor and disposable run identity
journey.expected_boundary: owner capability admission before any effectful operation

journey.action: wait for identity-bound game readiness with a bounded deadline
journey.expected_boundary: readiness wait returns typed unavailable/timeout without guessing a ready state

journey.action: discover, select and bind a disposable save profile
journey.expected_boundary: profile identity and generation are pinned before load

journey.action: resolve an explicit or generate-once seed and persist its witness
journey.expected_boundary: replay uses one seed identity and rejects a mismatched generation

journey.action: capture a fair-play observation through the owner projection
journey.expected_boundary: hidden/private fields are rejected and the observation carries identity/generation

journey.action: prepare a bounded decision request using only admitted context
journey.expected_boundary: decision source is pinned to a permitted profile and context revision

journey.action: dispatch one capability-gated action and reconcile its receipt
journey.expected_boundary: unknown or duplicate effects retain one operation identity and never redispatch blindly

journey.action: include a scoped context binding for the second invocation while explicitly omitting it from the first
journey.expected_boundary: membership is per invocation; unavailable bindings are not inferred from run/timeline identifiers

journey.action: select an allowed observation projection and preview its fields
journey.expected_boundary: projection is closed and preserves forbidden-field rejection

journey.action: consume an invocation-scoped context lifetime at dispatch
journey.expected_boundary: expiry is durable and a second dispatch fails closed

journey.action: replace an observation in the same semantic slot
journey.expected_boundary: the latest identity-bound observation wins without stale accumulation

journey.action: present a scoped persistent pin and attributed instruction for review
journey.expected_boundary: review metadata never grants write/control authority

journey.action: measure prepared input against the selected effective model/context budget
journey.expected_boundary: oversized input is rejected before provider dispatch with a bounded diagnostic

journey.action: hold, preview and approve the exact prepared application input
journey.expected_boundary: edits are revision-bound and dispatch requires explicit approval

journey.action: apply an authored truncation or reviewed-summary policy
journey.expected_boundary: history selection and compaction remain scoped, attributable and fail closed when unavailable

failure_matrix.stimulus: owner, context binding, provider or native adapter unavailable
failure_matrix.expected_result: typed unavailable result with no inferred identity or fallback effect

failure_matrix.stimulus: stale schema, capability, generation, profile or context revision
failure_matrix.expected_result: reject stale input and require a fresh exact pin

failure_matrix.stimulus: prepared input exceeds the effective budget
failure_matrix.expected_result: reject before provider dispatch and retain no raw provider payload

failure_matrix.stimulus: stop or cancellation races an unresolved operation
failure_matrix.expected_result: stop dominates; operation identity remains auditable and is not silently redispatched

failure_matrix.stimulus: owner process or host restarts between intent and receipt
failure_matrix.expected_result: recover by the same operation identity or report explicit unknown
hold and reconcile; never create a new mutating identity
